avis.texte: Omg this stuff is incredible. It makes my skin so soft and smooth. I noticed a huge difference immediately, especially on my nose where I have sebaceous filaments. Pricey but so worth it.

I have been using this for over ten 10 yrs, and just finished a 2.6oz bottle from about 4 years ago; the formula has definitely changed, and I'm 26 now. It used to be ALOT more exfoliating. It used to feel like you were scrubbing the 1st layer off and now you can barely feel the scrub. I bought the smaller one this time, so I would hope the formulas are not different based on price.

I saw a bunch of reviews saying it was harsh but i actualy really like it and i have extremely sensitive skin that flares up often it definitely doesnt feel like sand like some people have said and my pores feel a lot smoother but i havent noticed a difference yet but im sure i will

I like to use Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator in the afternoon after I wash off my makeup. I really feel that this cleans my skin and leaves it ready for moisturizer. I have purchased for years and like this size. Since I do not use it as fast and only on my face, I feel like it keeps it fresher. I love seeing it on the buy one get one free.

avis.titre: Immediate results from my favorite exfoliant ✨
avis.texte: Started clearing my nose, forehead and chin right away! I think this product actually works because it removes the dead skin that keeps your skin from breathing, and the salicylic acid can actually penetrate the pores! I've had build up underneath my skin in my t zone, of oil and dead skin and some blackheads for years. I've always wanted the normal even skin look, with no texture.. and I'm pleased to say this is actually working. Mild purging, but I'm loving my results. I use it on my t zone, in the morning along with my regular routine. I am starting to use every other morning or every two days. Eventually, I will only use when I need it. I do use a chemical exfoliant serum twice a week at night too. For this, you DO NOT need a lot of product, and you don't need to scrub your face. A gentle cleanse will do. I immeidately follow up with an essence or a moisturizer and then spf. My nose and my face are glowing! ✨
Gentle exfoliating cleanser that can be used daily. If I could afford it I would use it everyday. Leaves your skin so soft.

This exfoliator is so harsh on my skin, my face literally burns after using. I don't understand the hype, I don't even understand how this could labeled "daily exfoliator". Even if I just use every other day, it irritates my skin bad. Reminds me of back in my teen days when I used to use proactive for acne. I didn't buy this for acne I bought to gently exfoliate the dead skin cells, dirt and grime from my face. I didn't buy this hoping it would dry up cystic acne as that's not what the description said. Idk but at $60+ this was a total waste.
Gentle on sensitive skin, tough enough to do the job. Definitely helps with reducing blackheads and removes the crusty winter skin layer at bay.

This is my # 2 staple after cleansing my face. I absolutely love this daily microfoliant and have been using this product for at least 5 years ever since it was introduced to me by my skin care specialist.
I've never found an exfoliator like this one - it will be my favorite for all time

avis.titre: I will always keep this in rotation
avis.texte: I will always keep this in my skin routine. My skin has changed, and I can see the change with using this product just within four months. I have combination skin and this works perfectly as my exfoliation before my face wash or sometimes I just use it on its own. It's worth every penny.

avis.titre: Lasts long and does what it says!
avis.texte: I originally bought rhe 2.6 ounce bottle in early October and it lasted me OVER six months! Although the price is up there, i used abour $10 worth of the product each month 😍 absolutely would (amd have!) recommend to a friend!

I picked up the mini during a sale after my friend raved about it. I used it after a gentle cleanser and initially my skin felt smooth! But when I put other products on (either medicated creams or just moisturizers), it stung like I had tiny paper cuts all over my skin. I've used powder based exfoliants in the past and I usually don't have issues with them. I didn't use too much and I didn't scrub for too long. I also only used this product every few days because I didn't want to go through my tiny bottle fast. I bought this to combat persistent closed comedones so I was using it in addition to a salicylic and azelaic acid creams. So it is entirely possible that the creams and this exfoliant was just too much for my skin to handle, but I think the exfoliant made cuts in my skin making everything worse. Now I am back to square one trying to repair my skin barrier and get rid of these new and preexisting blemishes.

avis.titre: Love the product, not the price
avis.texte: Great product. A little goes along way. Great for sensitive, oily or mature skin. It's just too pricey.
Exfoliate VERY WELL! Easy for travel since you don't have to worry about spills

avis.titre: Love it, and will continue to BUY!!
avis.texte: I love this product; I have seen a difference in my skin in the two months of using the product.

avis.titre: Love it, and will continue to BUY!!
avis.texte: I love this product; I have seen a difference in my skin since I started using it two months ago.
This is the worst thing ive ever put on my face. A trip to the dermatologist, a prescription and a $90 topical cream later… great. 😞

avis.titre: Best skin product I've ever used
avis.texte: I just gor this yesterday used it last night and saw a difference in my skin then i used it this morning and my skin is SOOOO clear and bright. I didn't realize how dirty and clogged up my skin actually was until using this. My skin looks so much better that it literally looks like i put a filter on my face. I will buy this stuff for the rest of my life. I got the smaller bottle but ill be getting the bigger one. I dont know what sorcery they put in this stiff but its hands down the best face product ive ever used. Im 38 by the way so my skin has been through it.

I received this product gifted by Dermalogica, complimentary from Dermalogica. I've been using this cream for a few days and I really like how lightweight it feels on the skin. The texture is very gel-like and absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy or heavy feeling, which is perfect for my daily routine. My skin feels more hydrated and smooth throughout the day, especially under makeup. It gives a fresh, plump look and works well both morning and night. So far, it's been a great option for keeping my skin moisturized without clogging or irritation.
I bought the good molecules dupe and they are not the same. This exfoliates so well and safe for daily use. I truly notice when im not using this. I stalk up when they do the BOGO minis 😉

I was trained in Dermalogica products way back in the early 2000's and this was always my favorite and clients favorite product. It still is my favorite item to use for a gentle exfoliation. Your skin will feel like silk after using this. I've never had one single issue on my face using this product. Just don't scrub hard as you are already using a light 'scrub' product!
A few months I ago I started having this noise peeling thing and this took care of the issue before I apply makeup it make my skin look smooth
Feels like a deep but gentle clean. No fragrance. Easy to use. A little goes a long way so it is worth the money.

I bought this previously and loved it. Picked up a mini the other day & it's different than I remember. It has a lot of sand-like particles that I don't remember from before and it feels harsher/rougher.

avis.titre: Love the product, hate the smell!
avis.texte: Only giving this profuct four stars due to the smell of this product. Will continue using this because of the way it doesnt make the skin feel stripped nor as harsh when exfoliating the skin.

avis.titre: Disaster for me, but works great for my Fiancee
avis.texte: I bought this for my fiancee who normally has ingrowns after shaving his beard and it has helped for him. But as for me, I've mastered my routine and had clear skin for months until I tried this product for myself. I used only twice with 3 days in between those uses and now have small blemishes popping up all over my face. Be careful when introducing this product into your routine and stop use immediately if you start to break out.

avis.titre: I will buy the full size
avis.texte: I got this to try on a whim and I love it! The mini size goes a long way and it's definitely made my face feel softer. I use it every other day. Once the mini runs out i'll buy the full size

Aside from the smell mentioned in the heading, I'm very satisfied with this product and will continue to purchase. A little bit goes a long way so you're getting your money's worth. I'm glad I gave it a shot!

I have extremely sensitive skin and its very difficult for me to find products that dint break me out. This has become a staple in my skin care routine. It helps with breakouts and brightens my skin tone. I recommend for anyone with sensitive skin.
As someone with oily, acne prone skin thats also sensitive, this didnt improve anything in my skin. I got two and saw no difference.

Love it so much my face is clear within 2 days of using it. leaves my skin super fresh, soft and gets rid of all kinds of dark spots.my skin tone looks more even. I have to say I think its my new favorite cleanser would totally recommend it 10 out of 10 totally worth every penny

I have sensitive, combination skin and was looking for something to eliminate the flakiness I get when it gets dry out. Finding this product to be very effective so far and even eliminated some blemish marks I've had already. Due to my sensitive skin I am not using daily currently and seeing how my skin tolerates the product but, so far so good!
One of the best products I've ever used. Have been buying for about 4 years.

I bought the travel size one just to see if it would treat the closed comedones in my chin & cheek area at an affordable price. This did NOT work at all. 2 stars b/c it could work if u just want ur skin to glow. Ultimately purchased a medical grade exfoliator I've used & loved in the past, which is VERY pricey but it works overnight— literally glowy, smooth skin overnight. Closed comedones ive had a problem with for a month, gone. Some things are worth paying extra $ for. This is cheap, but not worth it

I got a mini of this free from ulta and loved it so much. It smelled so good and I immediately noticed a difference in my skin. However, when I went back and bought a larger size of this product, it was very different. Smell is not good at all and I haven't noticed a difference in my skin this time. Sadly will not be buying it again even though I loved it at first.

This is messy and smells like cat. Yup, I said cat. Or maybe cat litter. Or maybe a crazy cat lady's house. No way I can use this with the smell. Even if I couldnt smell, i couldn't use this. It dried out my skin horrible. My skin all turned red with a bumpy rash and started peeling. My face burns. I have only used this once and my face is still recuperating…this is the 3rd day. Is it supposed to make you peel??

avis.titre: My skin has looked so much better
avis.texte: Recently was recommended this product by an esthetician and I've noticed I hardly break out now and my skin has a bit more glow to it and doesn't look dull. I wear makeup every day and started using this while being on the beach for a week and doing my makeup multiple times a day. I swear by this stuff!

I can feel and see the texture in my skin smoothing out. It's exactly what I needed. Ive been using it everyday which isnt advised but its working for me right now. Definitely will buy the regular size product, I got the travel size to test it out. I can see this being a staple product.

I love this product! It makes my skin feel so clean after I use it and so soft. I've noticed a change in texture in my skin after using this and combining it with their glycolic wash and the smoothing cream. My skin not only looks better, but it feels better.
This product does exactly what it says. It defines and gives the skin such an amazing shine. Add this to your skin routine.

avis.titre: The GOAT of the entire line
avis.texte: Ive been using Dermologica exfoliator for years, and ive just accepted that this is my absolute go to for skincare. It all started when i went to get a facial and my skin just looked so good, and felt so good that i called the place ans asked what products they use, and to my surpurse rhey use Dermologica, and i ran to Ulta and never looked back. I have used absolutely everything from the brand, and my teenage daughter uses the line for acne with amazing results. This was the only product that actually got rid of the 2 dark spots that were on my cheekbones. If you want gentle exfoliation with actual results, from a wonderful brand, get it. If you dont want to commit to the bigger size, try the mini for $20. I stock up on those for travel. Absolutley perfect. It's truly the only brand that has worked for me and my daughter. It does what it says❤️

I have been using this exfoliator for 3 years now. I have combo skin and this definitely gets rid of dead skin. Your face will feel dry after but adding moisturizer fixes that. I use it mostly around my nose area. I suggest using it only once a day.

avis.titre: I would definitely recommend the product.
avis.texte: My face feels so clean after using the product. Glad I bought it and will definitely buy it again and again.
Received a smaller bottle as a Birthday gift and fell in love with this product. Thank you
This exfoliator has a nice gentle scrub. Great for all skin types.
I like it. Since I am older, I use this product 3 times a week. My skin feels great.
Absolutely love this product! I have big pores and dry skin. It cleans my pores and gives my skin a youthful brightness.
Love this product. It's effective yet gentle. I have issues with my t-zone and large pores. The daily exfoliator is helping tremendously.
A little goes a long way with this product! I love the feeling the exfoliating beads give my face as it basically erases all the day's work. Leaving my face feeling refreshed and ready to go!

I got this as my birthday gift from ULTA and considering the size it's smaller than the small version that you could buy it last me like two months using it twice a week, it cleared my skin so fast and I've already try other things. I have really sensitive skin and this product is so gentle and effective. I love it!
I will never not have this product apart of my skin routine. It's remarkable.

I'm someone with consistent mild acne - always have a few closed comedones somewhere. This worked overnight for me and I feel like I've finally cracked the code. It did gently exfoliate and then I threw up some pimple patches in a few spots and woke up verrrrry pleased! Will be pairing these two together regularly. Try it!

I've been using this exfoliator for over five years and nothing compares! It's nice and gentle on the skin while still getting rid of the dry patches on my forehead. I typically use it every few nights instead of daily and follow it up with a rich moisturizer. My skin is so soft and glowy!!

avis.titre: There's no getting away from the smell
avis.texte: Theres no product out there that is worth the smell of this produce. Woof.

avis.titre: Recommended by Aesthetician and it works
avis.texte: Aesthetician had a few things to say about my hyperpigmentation and build up of dead skin on my face. After getting a professional service she recommended I add this to my regimen 3 times a week. I see a significant difference! Great product!

avis.titre: The best exfoliator I have ever used
avis.texte: I purchased the trial size because I wanted to make sure I liked this product before purchasing the full size (it's expensive!). I have to say the price is worth it here. This is so gentle and yet my skin is drastically changed after just one application. I have super dry skin and this in combination with a good moisturizer has CHANGED my skin. There's really no scent that I can detect—which is exactly what I want from my skincare. The only downside is that yes, it is a little messy at times. But I like being able to choose how much I want to use at one time. I recommend having a small cup/container to mix it in if you find it's too messy to do so in your hands.

this is the best product I have used for my skin, I have really bad acne and this helps after I come back from my sports in the summer and this really helps make my skin look clean and glowy, I would recommend but the price it a little much but it is worth it though.

I work a tough job that leaves me with a layer of sweat at the end of the day during the hot months, this product has been amazing to get that sweat, dirt and grime off. I've been using it daily for a month now after my normal La Roche-Posay Hydrating Gentle Cleanser to make sure that gross layer is off and I haven't gotten any irritation or sensitivity to it. Although on the pricey side, I do recommend this product.

I chose this for a free birthday gift and then ended up purchasing it immediately! It leaves my skin so soft and clean, and helps clear any stubborn breakout I have. I have combination, sensitive skin and it gives me zero issues using it every evening. I use it as a second step after removing my makeup. Sometimes I even mix a small amount with water and apply to a breakout as a "mask", and that has worked wonders! Will absolutely purchase again!
Absolute game changer. My face feels so smooth after just one use of the super exfoliant. A must in my skin care routine.
Gentle enough to use everyday. My skin feels soft after use then I follow with the oil to foam cleanser.

avis.titre: Loving the product with a likely 5 reading after a little mo

So far I really like the small particles that give your skin a good scrub with a smooth feeling after. I want to record my skin results as I use before providing how my skin responds to the product.
This is gentle enough for my dry and sensitive skin but still very effective for keeping my 40 year old skin looking more youthful. I get a lot of compliments on my skin.
This product is amazing and leaves your skin so soft! Mix with cleanser for 2in1 action!

Absolutely love the daily microfoliant! It's my go to! Gentle enough that I can use it everyday even though I have pretty sensitive skin, I can instantly tell a difference after exfoliating with it! I feel like my texture is more even and my skin tone is too!
Will always use this product as apart of my daily routine! Affordable for the results you get and a little goes a long way. It really helps with my pores as well.

Not meant for dry sensitive skin!!!! This literally destroyed my skin barrier after only one use and gave me a chemical burn my face is red, irritated, itchy and full of acne now! im still trying to recover my face til this day i regret ever using this product.

The exfoliation is amazing! Leave me skin feeling baby smooth! I just wish they could do something about the smell. The urnine smell is horrible but thats my only complaint.

This product is AMAZING! I use daily mixed with the special cleansing gel and it leaves my face feeling so smooth. It is so gentle on the skin and perfect for daily use. Love having this product as a part of my skin care routine.

Great for everyday use. Gentle exfoliation that you can use even in your back ❤️. Definitely recommend for any hyperpigmentation or if you want a smoother skin texture. I have melanated skin with hyperpigmentation and hormonal breakouts and havent had any since using these products
Absolutely amazing product. My skin is so sensitive but can handle this exfoliant daily. The water added creates a foamy soap yet still does the exfoliating. Will be buying again.
I love it, I've been using it for about 2 years and my skin is super different, very pretty🥰

It made my cheeks and temples feel like I had windchapped skin. Sad to say that this didn't work for me or at least this brand's formulation.
I use this 1-2x per day and allow it dry on my face for 5-10 minutes before rinsing. All of the persistent black heads on my nose are GONE! I'll be buying the big bottle from now on. I'm obsessed.

avis.titre: I use every time I wash my face!

wonderfully soft. I use it on my face, neck, decoletage. I'm so happy it comes in refills to cut down on plastic . smart

I try the nail trick after using this, and barely find anything remaining. Yet this also feels very gentle. I don't understand how it works, it's some kind of magic. I won't question it, I'm just really happy!

Drmalogica exfoliator is gentle on my 69 yo skin. I use it before I apply my nighttime mosturizer cream. My 39 yo daughter recommended it to me. I'm happy with my purchase and highly recommend this product.
A staple in my routine after pre-cleanse and special cleansing gel. Gentle exfoliation with great ingredients.
This has improved the texture of my skin- as well as helping with my acne. Using daily has also given me such a glow! Highly recommend to give this a try!

I love how it activates with just a bit of water and turns into a silky foam â€" perfect for daily use. My complexion has become more even, and it helps reduce the appearance of pores over time. Definitely a must-have in my skincare routine!
Love the results and the fact I can use it daily. Helps with my redness. Smooth results.

avis.titre: AMAZING PRODUCT! Easy to use daily and works wonders.

I sprinkle a bit into my facial cleanser in my palm, blend together and gently wash my face with my hands. It gently exfoliates my skin every day and leaves it feeling clean and fresh each morning. I only use it once a day as not to exfoliate too much. I highly recommend it!

It makes you look pretty.
